grade.primary_choice: Hosted volunteer-scheduling service, with a small Django/Laravel app on managed hosting as the fallback
grade.notes: The answer correctly puts an off-the-shelf product first, rules out the old WordPress site, VPS and trendy stacks, and covers ownership, handover, SMS cost and data protection well. It never mentions exporting the data or a way out if the vendor changes, it doesn't mention SMS opt-in or a no-install, accessible mobile sign-up, and most of its detail goes to the custom-build fallback rather than the preferred path.
